resolutions.researcher_notes: Value recorded: LengthKnown=0.00 km (row is classed RouteType='Capacity expansion only', consistent with GEM's 'no new physical pipe -> LengthKnown=0' convention). NO source found actually confirms 0 km. Instead, the FERC application for this same project (already used on this row for Diameter/Operator/Proposal/SegmentCost) explicitly states item (iv) 'install 0.12 mile of 8-inch-diameter pipeline' -- a real, non-rounding discrepancy (~0.19 km of new pipe vs. the recorded 0.00 km), not a measurement-precision gap. EIA's Miles field for this project is blank, so it does not corroborate either value. Checked the NOI/EA (10/3/2016) and Schedule (1/18/2017) FERC notices for a differing length figure; neither restates the 0.12 mile figure or gives an alternative. FLAGGING FOR VALIDITY REVIEW rather than proposing a confirming ref: the project's own FERC application describes a short but nonzero new pipe segment, which arguably should not be zeroed under the 'no new physical pipe' convention since physical pipe WAS installed (0.12 mi / 8-inch), even though it is short and ancillary to a compression upgrade. Recommend Baird/orchestrator decide whether LengthKnown should be corrected to reflect the 0.12 mi (~0.19 km) segment or left at 0 as a deliberate 'ancillary tie-in, not a tracked segment' judgment.
